run_train_normal: run the train function with a config dict to train a model in normal mode
run_train_conformal: run the train function with a config dict to train a model in conformal mode
run_train_coverage: run the train function with a config dict to train a model in coverage mode
run_train_sgd: run the train function with an sgd optimizer and exponential learning rate schedule
run_train_adam: run the train function with an adam optimizer and step learning rate schedule
